svg.text: Blue: D president · Amber: R president · Gray: other/unknown
Only included windows with values known at origin. Valuation definition: Shiller workbook CAPE field. One definition is
shown at a time. No fitted relationship. Public CRSP-market-proxy annual reconstruction, 1955–2022 with frozen inherited
conditions; USD; NOMINAL; TOTAL_RETURN; CALENDAR_YEAR; CUMULATIVE; N=68 included windows; partial windows excluded;
endpoints exact dates; presidential-impact/0.2.0; political labels at origin; run
